canonical_inventory_method: SHA-256 of the source bundle's sorted canonical (group, version, kind, namespace, name) Kyverno inventory after only core-group and absent-namespace normalization.
coverage_gap: The captured Argo CD core diff timed out after 60 seconds with zero-byte stdout/stderr; parser compatibility is covered, but a completed live zero-diff result is not represented.
projection_method: Typed ApplicationList envelope plus the Kyverno Application name, health/sync status, and complete status.resources array. Resource keys are copied only when present, preserving absent/null/empty/populated distinctions. Operational metadata, specs, hostnames, UIDs, resourceVersions, timestamps, and identities are omitted.
